name: Green Leaf Grocer
shortDescription: Small independent greengrocer selling fresh fruit, veg and locally grown produce.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Wide aisles. Staff are happy to help read labels.

name: Sunrise Mini Mart
shortDescription: Family-run convenience store open until 11pm. Good range of everyday essentials.
accessibilityNotes: One small step at entrance. Narrow aisles in places.

name: Tesco Express
shortDescription: Large chain convenience store with a wide product range.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Accessible toilets available. Ask staff for the Tesco Accessibility Guide.

name: The Lamplight Café
shortDescription: Cosy independent café serving hot meals, sandwiches and good coffee. Free Wi-Fi.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Large-print menus available on request. Quiet corner seating.

name: Barista Brothers
shortDescription: Specialty coffee shop run by two brothers. Also sells pastries and light lunches.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Staff are trained to help visually impaired customers read menus.

name: Meridian Pharmacy
shortDescription: Independent pharmacy offering prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines and health advice.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Pharmacists can provide large-print medication labels on request.

name: Boots
shortDescription: Chain pharmacy and health and beauty store.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Accessible checkout lanes. Hearing loop available.

name: Fresh Start Launderette
shortDescription: Self-service launderette with large and small machines. Open 7am to 9pm.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Machine controls have tactile buttons. Staff on site until 6pm.

name: Borough Road Recycling Point
shortDescription: Council recycling point with separate banks for glass, textiles and small electricals.
accessibilityNotes: All banks are at ground level. Clear tactile labels on each opening. Fully accessible.

name: Student Union Building
shortDescription: Student union with a café, welfare office, study spaces and a free food bank for students.
accessibilityNotes: Fully accessible. Quiet rooms available. Disability support office on the ground floor.

name: University Library
shortDescription: Main university library with 24-hour access using your student card.
accessibilityNotes: Accessible entrance at the east door. Screen-reader computers on the ground floor. Book a one-to-one accessibility support session.

name: Neighbourhood Food Bank
shortDescription: Community food bank. Free food parcels for anyone in need — no referral required on Tuesdays.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Staff can read labels and help pack bags.

name: Khalil's Halal Butcher
shortDescription: Independent halal butcher selling fresh meat and a range of Middle Eastern groceries.
accessibilityNotes: One small step at entrance. Staff are very helpful and will explain products.

name: Canopy Books & Coffee
shortDescription: Independent bookshop with a café inside. Good for a quiet study break.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Audiobook section available. Staff can describe books on request.

name: Park Lane Bottle Bank
shortDescription: Council glass recycling bottle bank. Separate openings for clear, green and brown glass.
accessibilityNotes: Ground level. Openings are labelled in large print and with colour and tactile markers.
